international.title: Purse found of woman, 24, swept from California beach three weeks ago
international.summary: Se Nah Park was overwhelmed by a wave at the notorious Panther Beach The purse of a 24-year-old who was swept into the ocean at a notorious California beach three weeks ago was found on Wednesday, as the west coast saw record high king tides. The Santa Cruz county sheriff’s office confirmed that Se Nah Park’s purse was found by a beachgoer at 4 Mile Beach, south of Panther Beach, where she was swept away into the ocean on 8 November.
